sources.title: CAPP oil and gas infrastructure maps, October 2026
sources.method: Route names and facility capacities come from the two CAPP maps. Lines connect cities to show the general routes; they do not trace pipeline locations.
sources.limitations: The map includes selected infrastructure. Listed capacity differs from actual throughput. Facility markers show cities or approximate locations.

sources.title: Natural Earth boundaries and populated places
sources.method: Administrative boundaries use the 1:50 million dataset; country boundaries use 1:110 million. Selected cities use the 1:10 million populated-places dataset. Other route markers are approximate.
sources.limitations: Boundaries and locations are generalized. Consult detailed surveys before engineering or ground-disturbance work.
